properties.Caption: Show BOM/Routing (Partially Available)
properties.ToolTip: Specifies whether the BOM/Routing selection step is shown when only one of BOM or Routing exists. This setting only applies in Create Production Order mode. In Define Item Structure mode, the BOM and Routing steps are always shown in Edit mode.

properties.Caption: Show BOM/Routing (None Available)
properties.ToolTip: Specifies whether the BOM/Routing selection step is shown when neither a BOM nor a Routing exists. This setting only applies in Create Production Order mode. In Define Item Structure mode, the BOM and Routing steps are always shown in Edit mode.

properties.Caption: Show Prod. Components (Both Available)
properties.ToolTip: Specifies whether the components/routing preview steps are shown when both a BOM and a Routing exist. This setting only applies in Create Production Order mode. In Define Item Structure mode, the components and production routing steps are never shown.

properties.Caption: Show Prod. Components (Partially Available)
properties.ToolTip: Specifies whether the components/routing preview steps are shown when only one of BOM or Routing exists. This setting only applies in Create Production Order mode. In Define Item Structure mode, the components and production routing steps are never shown.

properties.Caption: Show Prod. Components (None Available)
properties.ToolTip: Specifies whether the components/routing preview steps are shown when neither BOM nor Routing exists. This setting only applies in Create Production Order mode. In Define Item Structure mode, the components and production routing steps are never shown.

properties.Caption: Always Save Modified Versions
properties.ToolTip: Specifies that newly created BOM/Routing versions are always kept even when the Save option is set to Empty when using the production order creation wizard.

properties.Caption: Allow Edit UI Selection
properties.ToolTip: Specifies that users can override the step visibility settings (Show/Edit/Hide) on the wizard introduction step.

properties.Caption: Default Prod. Wiz. Work Center No.

properties.Caption: Default Prod. Wiz. Component Item No.

properties.Caption: Default Prod. Wiz. Flushing Method
